entities.text: Oriental Insurance Co.Ltd vs Manhantesh Shivappa
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This appeal is filed by the appellant/Insurance Company challenging the judgment and award dated 28.03.2013 in MVC No.2000/2013 passed by the Senior Civil Judge and Additional MACT, Bailhongal (hereinafter referred to as 'the Tribunal' for short), seeking to reduce the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
3. The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.
NC: 2025:KHC-D:2307 i) Brust fracture D9 & D10 Vertebral body C Retropulsion of fracture fragments causing extradural compression on cre compression.

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge and Additional MACT, Bailhongal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
ii) Fracture spinous process of D6, D8, D9 & D10 Vertegra.
iii) Fracture Transverse process of D9 & D10 on right.
iv) Fracture pf 8th & 9th rib on right side.
v) Fracture of 8th and 9th left ribs.
vi) Grade I right renal injury.
vii) Fracture of lateral border of scapula left side.

3 viii) Fracture of occipital bone with Temporal parietal hemorrhage.
5. In the present case, the accident is caused on 19.05.2012 and the deceased died on 01.04.2013.

entities.text: Oriental Insurance Co.Ltd vs Manhantesh Shivappa on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the deceased died within a period of one year from the date of accident.
Upon considering the medical evidence on record, it is proved that the deceased suffered multiple fractured injures all over the body, including vital areas such as Vertebrae, Ribs and Scapula.
There was also a fracture of the occipital bone with temporal parietal hemorrhage and etc.

Consequently,
the deceased died within one year from the date of accident.
During the lifetime of the deceased the judgment was delivered on 20.03.2013 and the deceased died on 01.04.2013.
Therefore, upon considering the nature of injuries sustained by the claimant and quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal, it is found to be just and proper, which needs no interference.
Therefore, the appeal is liable to be dismissed.
7. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed.
8. Amount in deposit made by the appellant/Insurance Company shall be transmitted to the Tribunal.

Sd/-
